messages:
lina (AE): MerchantPrime just confirmed they want BYOK + hardware attestation during POC. They also listed target p95 keywrap <= 20ms and asked about emergency rollback SLA. Can SE/SRE confirm feasible for a 2-week POC?

raj (SE): Feasible but depends on deployment pattern. Quick summary: (A) Hosted + customer cloud-HSM (peered) => added network latency; typical p95 ~25-40ms. (B) Dedicated with our co-located key-proxy => p95 ~10-18ms based on recent runs. (C) On-prem HSM in their DC => depends on intra-dc network, usually similar to (B) if cross-connect is low-latency. We need to know if attacker-proof attestation is required from vendor (FIPS/CC specific report).

lina (AE): They explicitly want FIPS 140-2 Level 3 attestation and a vendor-signed HSM report.

kai (Security): We can provide a sanitized vendor attestation PDF for the POC. Full attestation handshake (customer key ceremony with vendor present) will require scheduling with their vendor and a dry-run. Add ~3 business days if cloud HSM, ~7 days if vendor onsite. For emergency rollback: we can document runbook + API to revoke keys and rewrap traffic; zero-downtime rollback requires cache draining strategy.

raj (SE): For the perf target (p95 <=20ms) I'm leaning Dedicated + 1x proxy colocated in the same AZ/colocation as the model servers. Need to disable long-lived prefix caching for the POC or set TTL very low so rotation semantics are validated. Also need to test with real-sized payloads (some of their calls hit 8k tokens).

tess (SRE): I can reserve a small Dedicated cluster for 2 weeks (2 GPU nodes) and enable token-level tracing + key op metrics. I'll also expose a /metrics endpoint with latency histograms. Firewall and peering checklist: open 443, permit mutual TLS, and allow port 12222 for vendor attestation channel. Will confirm provisioning ETA (48h once IAM and peering details are in).

lina (AE): Pricing ask from procurement: they want cost-per-transaction estimate and a capped ops surcharge for key ceremonies. Can someone provide a simple pricing model we can send?

raj (SE): Price drivers: reserved capacity cost (monthly commit), key-proxy ops (per-ceremony fixed fee), egress to customer HSM (if non-local), and per-KMS-op charge (we bill above baseline). For POC quote, give two options: Dedicated (commit) and Hosted-with-peering (no commit). I'll draft numbers with perf tradeoffs.

oncall-bot: Reminder: upcoming maintenance 2026-07-08 02:00-03:00 UTC may affect non-prod clusters.

kai (Security): Also: rotation frequency request — they asked for daily KEK rotation in the questionnaire. That is extreme. We should raise warning: daily KEK rotation increases key management complexity and greatly increases wrap/unwrapping overhead. Recommend ephemeral wrapping keys daily, KEK weekly/30d. If customer insists, require explicit SOW for runbook and monitoring.

lina (AE): I'll push back to request rationale for daily KEK and propose our recommended baseline.

sophia (CSM): MerchantPrime asked for test vectors and a test harness. SE: can you include a small workload that simulates their 8k token calls and a rotation script? Also want a scripted failure that simulates vendor unavailability so we can validate fallbacks.

raj (SE): Yep — will provide a harness and a small k6 script + sample curl commands. Example snippet: ```bash
# rotation simulation
for i in $(seq 1 200); do
  curl -s -X POST https://redwood.example/v1/kms/wrap -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"key_id":"cust-kek","plaintext":"payload-'$i'"}'
  done
# trigger rotation
curl -X POST https://redwood.example/v1/kms/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"key_id":"cust-kek","rotation_type":"hot"}'
```
Will include latency capture and sample grafana dashboard JSON.

lina (AE): Great. Can we agree deliverables and timeline? MerchantPrime wants POC start 2026-06-08. We need artifacts by 2026-06-04 EOD to prep. Deliverables: SE -> harness + runbook; SRE -> Dedicated reservation + metrics URL; Security -> sanitized attestation + rotation playbook; AE -> two pricing scenarios + SOW language for ceremonies.

tess (SRE): Confirmed reservation pending IAM/peering info. I will post the network checklist and turnaround ETA in the POC channel.

kai (Security): Will redact attestation and post by 2026-06-04. I'll also ask Legal about split-key contractual language if they require M-of-N.

sophia (CSM): I'll schedule kickoff and include a vendor-attestation slot in week 2 if they opt for real ceremony.

lina (AE): Perfect. Tag me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
